name: Makishima Haru
source:
Occupation: Student
Stay as: Dweller

Haru is a shy, high school student from Fujiyoshi. She can be a little ambiguous in her manner, sometimes saying things that no one understands.

Haru is [url=/c87425]Kanzo's[/url] granddaughter, and lives in room 201 of the student dorm.

[Taken from the official art book included with the [url=/r65525]Day One Edition[/url].]
